script:
control-agent-server conversation send "$W" --text 'hi' --no-run
control-agent-server ws start "/sockets/events/$W" --name f05-w-step --duration 300
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$W/run" --expect 200 --check success eq true
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$W/events/count" --query kind=$ACTION_KIND --check . eq 1 --until-ok 30
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$W/pause" --expect 200 --check success eq true --timeout 60 --save F05.pause-tool-step/pause
control-agent-server ws read f05-w-step --contains '"key": "full_state"' --expect-min 3 --wait 30
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$W" --check execution_status eq paused --save F05.pause-tool-step/get
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$W/events/search" --query kind=$OBSERVATION_KIND \
  --check items len-eq 1 --check items.0.observation.content.0.text contains QA_F05_STEP_DONE --save F05.pause-tool-step/observation
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$W/events/count" --query kind=$PAUSE_KIND --check . eq 1
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$W/events/count" --query kind=$ACTION_KIND --check . eq 1
control-agent-server sink read --name qa-f05-step --expect-min 1 --expect-max 1
control-agent-server ws stop f05-w-step --contains '"key": "execution_status", "value": "paused"' --save F05.pause-tool-step/frames
